verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management and agent platform, not a code-hosting, code-review or coding-agent product, so reviewing code diffs and commenting on specific lines is outside its product category. The evidence never shows it shipping a code-review surface. Linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items and messaging agents in updates are adjacent features. They do not provide line-level review of agent code changes from mobile.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
